title: Oltron: Algorithm-Hardware Co-design for Outlier-Aware Quantization of LLMs with Inter-/Intra-Layer Adaptation
problem: LLMs contain outliers (exceptionally high magnitude values) that critically affect model accuracy, and existing mixed-precision quantization techniques using value-wise outlier granularity struggle to balance accuracy with hardware efficiency.
motivation: Efficient outlier-aware quantization is critical for deploying LLMs on hardware accelerators while preserving model accuracy.
method: Oltron leverages the observation that activation outliers cluster within specific channels to enable channel-wise quantization. It comprises: (1) a quantization algorithm identifying optimal outlier ratios per layer and channel group, (2) a reconfigurable architecture supporting inter- and intra-layer adaptation, and (3) a tile-based dataflow optimizer orchestrating computation and memory access for mixed-precision tensors.
key_novelty: Channel-granularity outlier clustering enables reconfigurable inter-/intra-layer adaptive hardware design for mixed-precision LLM quantization.
contributions: Channel-aware quantization algorithm with optimal per-layer and per-channel-group outlier ratio identification
Reconfigurable hardware architecture supporting inter- and intra-layer distribution adaptation
Tile-based dataflow optimizer for efficient mixed-precision tensor computation and memory access
1.9x performance and 1.6x energy efficiency improvements over OliVe while enhancing model accuracy
primary_theme: Outlier-aware quantization for LLM inference acceleration
